notes:
GREENFIELD: no code, no go.mod, no tests yet. Commands below were verified in a scratch module at /tmp (Go 1.26.0, module path github.com/Teeeep/talaria, cmd/talaria + internal/spec layout) — they all pass there, but `go test ./...` in THIS repo currently fails with 'directory prefix . does not contain main module' until the first task runs `go mod init github.com/Teeeep/talaria` (remote is https://github.com/Teeeep/talaria.git). Treat `go mod init` as a prerequisite of the first build iteration.

Test layout: Go colocates tests with source, so source_dirs and test_dirs are intentionally identical — *_test.go files live next to the code in cmd/ and internal/. Expect a testdata/ directory for OpenAPI spec fixtures. test_single_command uses shell $(dirname) to turn a *_test.go path into its package; it must be run through a shell (bash -c), not exec'd directly.

Lint: golangci-lint is NOT installed (no ~/go/bin, not on PATH). The recorded lint is stdlib-only. Note that plain `gofmt -l .` exits 0 even when files are unformatted — hence the `test -z "$(...)"` wrapper, which was verified to exit 1 on an unformatted file. If a later phase installs golangci-lint, prefer it and update this file.

No CI config exists (.github/, .woodpecker.yml, Makefile all absent), so no CI-derived commands were available. No .claude/agents/ and no reviewer sections in the docs, so reviewer names are generic. Reviewer rationale: `security` is not routine here — the credential firewall (DESIGN.md §5a) IS the product, and DESIGN.md mandates a canary-secret CI suite in Phase 2 that greps every output surface (json/pretty/tsv/dry-run/errors/junit/history/corpus/debug logs) for injected secrets and fails the build on a leak. `concurrency` for the Phase 6+ twin HTTP server and recording proxy. `integration` for the CLI + twin server + proxy multi-process loop.

Runtime deps: system curl is the execution engine and DESIGN.md sets a hard floor of curl >= 7.70 (needs --write-out '%{json}'). Installed here: curl 8.14.1 — satisfied. Go toolchain: go1.26.0 at /usr/local/go/bin/go. Module proxy is reachable (verified via `go list -m -versions github.com/spf13/cobra`), so dependency downloads work.

No database, no services, no .env required for Phases 1-4. Phase 7+ adds a bbolt store; consider adding a `performance` reviewer then. There are no pre-commit hooks. .gitignore already excludes /talaria, /dist/, /twin-data/, *.corpus/, .env* and config.local.yaml.

Planning inputs: docs/design/DESIGN.md is the source of truth (README.md says so explicitly) and contains an 8-phase roadmap in §7 with a deliberate decision gate after Phase 4. tasks.json at repo root points plan_file at IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, which does not exist yet.
